## Purpose

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run prepare:standalone`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Browser validation of the actual standalone server, including Server Action submission
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests updated
- [ ] No secrets, environment files, installed dependencies, or build output included

Distinguish local standalone checks from live Builder deployment results.

## Breaking changes

Describe any changed routes, environment variables, or deployment behavior.
